# NoiseModulatedBackprop

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method to reconstruct backpropagation gradients from forward-pass fluctuations induced by injected noise in neural network activations. Enables training without explicit backward pass, which is crucial for in-network neuromorphic hardware where backward connectivity is costly or unavailable.
